name: Stilt Fella
description:
A highly challenging physics-based arcade game about walking on stilts and overcoming obstacles.

Features:
- Increasingly difficult stilt walking challenges spread across over 50 LEVELS!
- Show off your unique style with a CUSTOMIZABLE FELLA!
- Compete with other players on the ONLINE LEADERBOARDS!
- Compete with friends in the LOCAL HOTSEAT MULTIPLAYER MODE!
